purpose: Read-only visual review of actual beta.10 island/external captures; no application changes or release approval.
method: Actually viewed every frame using view_image on all eleven 2x2 contact sheets. Each tile is 480x854 original pixels; independently verified all 44 raw SHA256 values and exact pixel identity between tiles and raw PNGs. Additionally viewed the raw low-contrast frame directly. No image manipulation was used to assess rendering.
rendering_status_scope: One captured frame fails system-bar readability; 43 others pass the observed rendering review. This is not a finding that every runtime state has been tested.

findings.observed: In this original light Hebrew compact demo, white time/status glyphs have very low contrast against the near-white bar; the green mic privacy indicator is visible. Bottom system navigation icons are not visibly distinguishable. The island body remains legible. Other captured light demo peers show gray system icons.
findings.limit: Observed in one captured frame only. No live reproduction or root cause has been established; no claim that this persists or affects production external overlays. The native settings-bar contrast boolean is not used to override the pixels.

findings.observed: The floating keypad overlaps part of a lower visible row call control in the compact list captures. Lower list rows and names/dates are also bounded by the scrolling viewport or ellipsis. The expanded island reduces the visible list area while favorites/search/summary/navigation remain legible.
findings.limit: No pointer reachability or scroll behavior is inferred from these still frames. The raw fixture proof separately records list-anchor restoration.

evidence_context.external_origin: Raw external-island-native.json records actual emulator GSM modem -> Android Telecom -> production PhoneSessionService, not injected Call/session.
evidence_context.static_fixture_origin: Raw island-native.json identifies non-exported DEBUG fictional contacts/state using the production renderer/controller. Style/state demos and MainActivity synthetic-list captures do not prove physical Telecom/audio behavior.
evidence_context.protected_settings: There is no dedicated protected-Settings PNG among these 44. Raw native proof records Android Settings hiding the overlay, preserving the call and ongoing notification return/hang-up intents; protected Settings visual appearance is not independently approved here.
evidence_context.external_native_proof_summary: Raw proof records HOME and Clock windows, native SystemUI answer acknowledgement, mute acknowledgement, return/Back/query preservation without a duplicate island, end/cancel/confirm/cleanup, denied/regranted overlay permission and modem-end cleanup. These are raw runtime proof observations, distinct from screenshot rendering.

speaker.visible_result: The actual external expanded captures omit the unsupported Speaker button. Speaker buttons present in DEBUG style demos represent the fixture, not a verified real route switch.

release_context.native_expected_failure: testBundledBusinessDirectoryNativeIsolationSearchAndProvenance: bundled production business dataset is MISSING.

not_tested: Protected Settings visual screenshot outside this 44-frame set
